## Checking model assumptions

```{r}
#| label: set-up
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(targets)
library(tarchetypes)
library(tidyverse)
library(performance)
library(see)
library(DHARMa)

# Set targets store path
tar_config_set(store = "../_targets")

tar_load(big_data)
# Function to get pretty labels for responses
pretty_labels <- big_data |> 
  distinct(response) |> 
  mutate(label = as.character(response)) # Simplified label for now
```

## Multifunctionality

```{r}
#| label: multifunctionality-check
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 12

tar_load(model_multifunctionality, store = "../_targets")
tar_load(model_multifunctionality_main, store = "../_targets")

# Define model sets defensively
models_to_check <- list()
if (exists("model_multifunctionality") && !is.null(model_multifunctionality)) {
  models_to_check[["Interaction: Model 1 (Climate)"]] <- list(df = model_multifunctionality, col = "model")
  models_to_check[["Interaction: Model 2 (Total Biomass)"]] <- list(df = model_multifunctionality, col = "model_biomass")
  models_to_check[["Interaction: Model 3 (FG Biomass)"]] <- list(df = model_multifunctionality, col = "model_FG_biomass")
}
if (exists("model_multifunctionality_main") && !is.null(model_multifunctionality_main)) {
  models_to_check[["Main Effects: Model 1 (Climate)"]] <- list(df = model_multifunctionality_main, col = "model_main")
  models_to_check[["Main Effects: Model 2 (Total Biomass)"]] <- list(df = model_multifunctionality_main, col = "model_main_biomass")
  models_to_check[["Main Effects: Model 3 (FG Biomass)"]] <- list(df = model_multifunctionality_main, col = "model_main_FG_biomass")
}

for (label in names(models_to_check)) {
  cat("\n###", label, "\n")
  models_to_check[[label]]$df |>
    pwalk(function(...) {
      x <- list(...)
      mod <- x[[models_to_check[[label]]$col]]
      if (!is.null(mod)) {
        cat("\n#### Level:", x$level, "\n")
        print(check_model(mod))
        cat("\n")
      }
    })
}
```

## Single function analyses

```{r}
#| label: single-function-check
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 12

tar_load(model_single_function, store = "../_targets")
tar_load(model_single_function_main, store = "../_targets")

# Define model sets defensively
single_models_to_check <- list()
if (exists("model_single_function") && !is.null(model_single_function)) {
  single_models_to_check[["Interaction: Model 1 (Climate)"]] <- list(df = model_single_function, col = "model")
  single_models_to_check[["Interaction: Model 2 (Total Biomass)"]] <- list(df = model_single_function, col = "model_biomass")
  single_models_to_check[["Interaction: Model 3 (FG Biomass)"]] <- list(df = model_single_function, col = "model_FG_biomass")
}
if (exists("model_single_function_main") && !is.null(model_single_function_main)) {
  single_models_to_check[["Main Effects: Model 1 (Climate)"]] <- list(df = model_single_function_main, col = "model_main")
  single_models_to_check[["Main Effects: Model 2 (Total Biomass)"]] <- list(df = model_single_function_main, col = "model_main_biomass")
  single_models_to_check[["Main Effects: Model 3 (FG Biomass)"]] <- list(df = model_single_function_main, col = "model_main_FG_biomass")
}

for (label in names(single_models_to_check)) {
  cat("\n###", label, "\n")
  single_models_to_check[[label]]$df |>
    pwalk(function(...) {
      x <- list(...)

```
